verdict.rationale: Mem0's CLI supports explicit delete of memories, and self-hosting gives full data ownership plus audit logs, giving users real deletion control. However, the featured retention mechanism (expiration_date) explicitly does NOT delete data — docs state 'Nothing is deleted,' it merely stops surfacing expired memories in search, which undercuts a true deletion/retention story. Missing for 10: documentation of bulk/GDPR-style data purge or export-then-delete workflows, clarity on backend retention after 'delete', and independent confirmation that delete actually removes underlying data.
